import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # will be replaced with the sanitized title and content respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Formats and sanitizes a user‑submitted blog entry for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or headline of the blog post. text : str The full body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post. Notes ----- * The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any HTML or script content that might be injected by an attacker. * ``BLOG_FORMAT`` is a minimal template; it can be extended with additional attributes or CSS classes as needed. * This implementation guards against CWE‑707 (Improper Neutralization) by ensuring that all user input is escaped before being inserted into the template. """ # Escape any potentially dangerous characters in the title and body. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # The blog body may contain legitimate line breaks and paragraphs. # We escape it first, then replace newlines with
tags to preserve # formatting in the rendered HTML. escaped_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) safe_body = escaped_body.replace("\n", "
") # Insert the sanitized content into the template. formatted_entry = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_entry
